title: Closest to Space

script.text: The closest point to space isn't on Everest. It's on a volcano in Ecuador.

script: Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.
Chimborazo, in Ecuador, reaches only about [6,263|six thousand two hundred sixty-three].

script.text: That's over two and a half kilometers lower.

script: But Earth isn't a perfect ball.
It spins, and the spin makes it bulge at the equator.

script.text: The radius there is about [21|twenty-one] kilometers longer than at the poles.

script: Everest sits [28|twenty-eight] degrees north of the equator.

script.text: Chimborazo sits just [1|one] degree south. Right on top of the bulge.

script: Now measure from the center of the Earth.

script.text: Chimborazo's summit is about [6,384|six thousand three hundred eighty-four] kilometers out.
Everest's summit is over [2|two] kilometers closer.

script: And the tallest mountain from base to peak? Mauna Kea, in Hawaii.

script.text: Over [10,000|ten thousand] meters, most of it underwater.

script: Only one of them is Everest.
